events.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need from me?
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and point people to the sign-up list?
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and send people to the sign-up list. If you want, I can also help remind a few neighbors directly.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Jules: I can help connect folks for the repair drive and keep everyone on the same page. What still needs to be coordinated?
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Vik: Great — we still need to line up the volunteers, confirm the tool drop-off, and make sure everyone knows the start time.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Jules: I can reach out to the volunteer group and confirm who’s bringing what. Once I’ve got the drop-off details, I’ll share the start time with everyone.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — could you check what tools and supplies we already have and let me know what you can bring? I’m trying to avoid doubling up.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can check what we’ve already got and then bring whatever’s still missing so we don’t duplicate anything. If you send me the current list, I’ll compare it and circle back.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Pia: That’d be great, Jules. I’ll send the current list over so we can avoid any duplicates.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I may have missed the latest update, but I know they were still short on a few tools and extra hands.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Jules: I can help with that — I’ll check on extra volunteers and see what tools are still needed. If you want, I can also pass the update along so everyone’s in the loop.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Noah: That’d be great, Jules — I really appreciate it. I may have missed a few updates, so please pass along whatever you find.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Jules: I can help with that — what still needs to be coordinated for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Jules — I’m running a little late, but I’ll still come by and help with whatever’s left, like the fence panels or the mailbox.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Dane — that helps a lot. I’ll let the others know you’re coming, and I’ll check whether the fence panels or mailbox still need attention.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring my hammer, screwdriver set, tape measure, and a couple wrenches. If anything else is needed for the repair drive, just let me know and I’ll add it.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — that covers a lot. I’ll check the current list and let you know if anything else is still needed so we don’t duplicate gear.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll keep my tool bag ready, and just ping me if the list changes.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — if you can keep spreading the word and point folks to the sign-up list, that’d be a big help.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and send people to the sign-up list, and I’ll share any updates so everyone stays in the loop.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — that really helps. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear any update on the repair drive.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Jules: I can do that — I’ll check on the remaining tools and extra volunteers, then pass the update along so everyone stays in the loop.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Kira: Thanks — just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for this weekend, right?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Jules: Yes — it’s still on for this weekend, and I’ll share the latest update once I’ve checked on the tools and volunteers.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and check back after lunch so we can make sure everything’s ready.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Quinn — that’s really helpful. Check back after lunch and I’ll help keep everything coordinated.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll check back after lunch and keep spreading the word so everything stays on track.
events.speaker: Quinn
